policy.purpose: bounded triage only; no mask, composite, critic or manifest mutation
policy.bodyLockedTargets: diagnostic only; never substitute for the original full redraw and never publish
policy.wholeAtlasDelta: priority hint only; it cannot certify body preservation because the wearable mask is not yet known
policy.nextGate: run preflight-redrawn-wearable, then exact mask-only audit and independent critic
